verdict.rationale: Logseq documents a local HTTP API server for external access to the graph, protected by a bearer token. It exposes a single POST /api endpoint that dispatches any method from the plugin API docs and ships worked curl examples, so an external agent can drive the graph programmatically. The server is switched on in the app's Features settings and is described as part of the desktop app, so 'headless' operation is only partly evidenced. A community user also reports losing the ability to have Claude or Codex write pages under the new DB version. missing for 10: explicit evidence of specific read and write methods, a truly headless mode that works without the desktop app running, an OpenAPI spec or MCP server, and independent hands-on confirmation that agent read/write works via the API.
